description: RescueGrid demo timeline (18 events; the seismic sensor reports for 5 s before the quake at t=5). ONE clock for every replay adapter. t = seconds after scenario_start. Entity ids match the seeded graph (Shresth/rescuegrid/neo4j/schema/seed_static.cypher). Every event is the six-field contract + optional details; the adapter for its source posts it to the event bus at t. Owner: Shresth. Add events, keep the story coherent.

drone_vision.adapter: Aditya/Shresth  scenario/replay.py --sources drone_vision: events with a video in details.media are played through Aditya's vision v2 (:8091) with his replay adapter; v2 posts the claim itself. Scripted claim = expected result, posted only with --scripted-vision or if vision is down

radio_asr.adapter: Pranay  radio TTS -> ASR :8090 -> claim; until then scenario/replay.py --sources radio_asr posts the scripted claim with the transcript

details.note: Seismic sensor 1 measuring: quiet. Five seconds of readings before the quake.
t=5: the earthquake, after five seconds of live readings.
Drone 1 over downtown sees Building 14 down. Clip -> vision v2 -> `Building-14 collapsed` ~0.93 at t+3 s.

details.transcript: Dispatch, Engine 7, Main Street is blocked between Oak and Third, debris across all lanes.
details.speaker: Engine 7

details.note: Drone 1 pans to Main Street: debris across the lanes, second source after radio -> CONFIRM. Clip -> vision v2 -> `Main Street blocked` ~0.98 at t+1 s.
Vision confirms the GPS-derived NEAR: same edge, second source. Scripted (v2 cannot identify which team it sees).
Holding at Lincoln HS staging area.
Road camera 3: River Road moving, congested but open. Clip -> vision v2 tier 1 only -> `Road-River open` at the 3rd frame.
Gas sensor 3 next to Building 14 spikes 75 s after the collapse -> Hazard AFFECTS Building-14, Rescue 4 inside the radius.

details.text: Rescue 4 on scene Building 14, beginning primary search. Gas odor reported at north entrance.

details.transcript: Ambulance 2, Bridge Street looked clear when we passed ten minutes ago.
details.speaker: Ambulance 1
details.note: Stale-ish radio claim. Sets up the conflict.
Drone 2 shows Bridge Street under water 15 s after radio said open -> CONFLICT kept on Road-Bridge, both sides visible. Clip -> vision v2 -> `Road-Bridge blocked` ~0.96 (flooded_road) at t+1 s.

details.text: County General reports 12 beds available, ER accepting.
